tools.name: prepare_pickleball_browse
tools.description: Find public MYOPL pickleball courts, clubs and open play league listings for a city, state or country. Returns up to five listings with source links for a selected category, or category choices when none is selected. Live availability and bookings are not included.

tools.name: search_pickleball_rules
tools.description: Search the validated official 2026 USA Pickleball Rulebook, used by MYOPL under an official licensing agreement with USA Pickleball. Returns English evidence, edition and rule citations, with grounded answers or requests for clarification when available. The complete licensed rulebook is not provide

tools.name: search_myopl_help
tools.description: Search published MYOPL Help Center articles by feature or task. Returns matching instructions and source links without accessing accounts or conversations.

tools.name: search_myopl_website
tools.description: Search published MYOPL product and website information by topic. Returns matching public pages and source links without accessing accounts or conversations.

tools.name: get_public_player_rating
tools.description: Look up current published OPL ratings by exact public username without sign-in. Returns singles and doubles ratings, Reliability Score, game and point totals, source links and a Messenger profile invitation link. Compatible clients can display one MYOPL rating card.
